title: List work
summary: List the environment's work items newest first. limit bounds the page and page carries the keyset cursor the previous page's next_page returned; a cursor this route did not issue is refused rather than rewound. Requires queue authority — an environment worker key or a managed API key; a session work token is refused.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page's next_page.

response.name: data
response.description: One page of work items; secret is null on this path.

response.name: next_page
response.description: Cursor for the next page, null at the end.

title: Retrieve work
summary: Retrieve one work item through the same item-scope fence as the item verbs: an environment mismatch answers 404, and a session work token reads only its own session's items.

response.name: work
response.description: The work item; secret is null on this path.

title: Work queue stats
summary: Queue counters for the environment, read from the lease model: depth is what a poll could hand out now, pending is claimed-but-unacknowledged work inside its lease, oldest_queued_at spans the same live population, and workers_polling counts identities seen on poll in the last 30 seconds. Requires queue authority; a session work token is refused.

title: Poll for work
summary: Long-poll for the next claimable work item in an environment. Returns a work item whose secret carries a per-claim session token (base64url JSON with sessions_token and api_base_url), or 204 when nothing is claimable before block_ms expires. The work item is a session-scoped projection of the local tool-execution queue: data is always {type: 'session', id}. Authenticate with an environment worker key or a managed API key; Anthropic-Worker-ID identifies the claiming worker.

parameters.name: block_ms
parameters.description: How long to wait for work before returning 204. 1-999 milliseconds; omitted polls return immediately.

parameters.name: reclaim_older_than_ms
parameters.description: Reclaim claimed-but-unacknowledged items older than this; defaults to 5000ms.

headers.name: Anthropic-Worker-ID
headers.description: Worker identity; owns the claim lease and feeds the workers_polling stat.

response.name: work
response.description: Claimed work item with secret populated, or HTTP 204 with no body when empty.

title: Acknowledge work
summary: Acknowledge a claimed work item, committing the holder to running it — the transition the published contract calls queued to starting. A stopped item or a lapsed lease answers 409 work_lease_lost; an Anthropic-Worker-ID naming a different holder answers 409.

response.name: work
response.description: The acknowledged work item; secret is null on this path.

title: Heartbeat work lease
summary: Renew the heartbeat lease on a work item. expected_last_heartbeat=NO_HEARTBEAT claims the heartbeat lease on the first beat; later beats echo the returned last_heartbeat and a mismatch answers 412 with the server's current_state under error.details.current_state. A stopped or terminal item answers 200 with lease_extended: false and state stopping or stopped — the shutdown signal, not an error.

parameters.name: expected_last_heartbeat
parameters.description: Optimistic concurrency precondition; NO_HEARTBEAT claims an unclaimed heartbeat lease.

parameters.name: desired_ttl_seconds
parameters.description: Accepted but not honored per item; the response reports the effective queue lease as ttl_seconds.

response.name: last_heartbeat
response.description: Recorded heartbeat anchor to echo on the next beat.

response.name: lease_extended
response.description: Whether the lease was renewed; false is the shutdown signal.

response.name: state
response.description: The work item's current projected state.

title: Update work metadata
summary: Merge a metadata patch onto a work item: a string value upserts the key, null deletes it, omitted keys are preserved. There is no result channel on this surface — the local /v1/x/worker/complete route remains the completion path.

response.name: work
response.description: The updated work item; secret is null on this path.

title: Stop work
summary: Record a stop decision for a work item. The item can never be claimed again and the holder learns from its next heartbeat, which reports lease_extended: false with state stopping. force selects graceful vs forced on the published wire; the local marker is already the immediate form, so both reach the same outcome.

response.name: work
response.description: The work item as stopped; secret is null on this path.
